decisions.reason: This yogurt remains a close extension of the firm's core organic dairy know-how and its earlier award suggests interpretable market acceptance, so our absorptive capacity to refine and support it stays high despite limited recent visibility.
As a strategically highlighted cheese variant built directly on established cheese capabilities, it fits our knowledge base and brand direction very well, making withdrawal unlikely.

The semi-hard cheese wheel is still well within our existing competence, but because it was never as prominent as the flagship products and we have already pruned weaker cheese lines before, it carries the highest discontinuation risk of the three.
